the role of internal services and their relationship with performance in software-as-a-service.

the service-dominance view of service is a useful framework for understanding the performance of SaaS.

service providers need to focus on their relationship-specific services and internal services, which are critical for the success of their software-as-a-service business.

internal services play a critical role in motivating clients to collaborate with vendors and thus improve the performance of the vendor.
